messages:
liz: quick heads-up — new hire Maya K's background check returned an 'address mismatch' flag this morning. start date currently set for Mon. need to confirm I-9 verification plan and whether we should postpone day‑1 to Tue while candidate sorts docs. any objections?
jess (recruiter): ah dang. candidate is on travel till Mon afternoon, told me she can push day‑1 to Tue if needed. she really wants Mon but understands if we need more time.
amelia (onboarding): we can do remote I-9 via an authorized agent. if candidate can provide a photo ID + recent mail/bank stmt we can clear the address mismatch. recommend giving her the list of acceptable docs and a 24h window.
luis (security): need a scanned photo of the ID *and* a proof of address showing current residence; SSN fine but not necessary for addr check. also run the candidate's current address against the travel itinerary — if it's a temp address that explains the mismatch.
jess (recruiter): noted. i already asked for a utility bill and gov ID, she's looking for the bill. also says her current address is still the one on appl, but she's staying at a hotel for a week.

liz: okay — two questions: 1) can we ship laptop to hotel address if she wants to start Mon? 2) will hr be comfortable clearing her for day‑1 orientation if docs arrive by eod Mon?
tom (it-ops): we can ship to a hotel but need a confirmation email from the candidate with hotel name + room number and an expected check-in date. ops will only release on signature. ETA for same-day ship is tight; EOD Mon delivery unlikely unless overnight. tracking sample: `1Z999AA10123456784`
amelia (onboarding): if docs arrive by eod Mon and ID checks out, we can keep the remote onboarding block at 10am Mon but make it optional for the candidate to join. otherwise shift formal onboarding to Tue 10am and schedule a 30m catch-up Mon evening to hand off logistics.
luis (security): if you plan to clear based on scans, put a 72h provisional hold: no access to internal services until final verification & badge issuance. :no_entry_sign:
jess (recruiter): i've pinged candidate for the utility bill and hotel confirmation. she replied: "i can send a pic of my license and a PDF of my hotel confirmation now" — should i ask for anything else?

liz: ask for license front/back + one proof of address (pdf/photo). confirm whether mailing address is permanent or temporary. mention that laptop may ship to hotel but only w/ signed confirmation. copy of hotel reservation is fine.
tom (it-ops): also need the full legal name and preferred machine image (macbook-pro / linux-workstation). i'll stage a laptop but hold shipment until we have written confirmation.
amelia (onboarding): sending candidate the onboarding packet now — includes link to e-form and i-9 checklist. Paste the e-form link below so we have a record: `https://redwood.example/onboard/forms/eform?hire=MayaK`
jess (recruiter): sent. candidate replied with photos at 1805001300, attached hotel res and license. forwarding to liz and luis.
luis (security): reviewed photos — license looks valid, hotel res shows name + dates. address on license still matches application address. mismatch probably due to overnight stay. i'm okay with provisional clearance pending a utility bill or bank stmt within 48h.
luis (security): note: no VPN or internal repo access until final OK. please create a limited-firewall account if they need to test infra during day‑1.

hr-bot: Reminder set: "Follow up: Maya K docs" scheduled for 1805080000.

liz: summary: keep day‑1 tentatively Mon 10am as optional, ship laptop once we have hotel confirmation + candidate sign-off, grant provisional access only, final clearance when utility/bank stmt received (48h). assigning actions: jess — confirm docs sent to onboard@ and get hotel confirmation in writing; tom — stage laptop, hold shipment; amelia — send e-form + i-9 agent instructions to candidate; luis — standby to validate scans. any concerns? :thumbsup:
jess (recruiter): :thumbsup: will update candidate and slack when done.
amelia (onboarding): :thumbsup:
tom (it-ops): staging laptop now. will await ship go-ahead.
luis (security): good plan. I'll tag security ops if anything suspicious.
liz: thanks team — i'll circle back with final plan by 1805002000.
